title: Roamhaven Listings Space Type Schedule: Capacity, Bedrooms, Photos and Inspection
content:
# Space Type Schedule — Capacity, Bedrooms, Photos and Inspection

Every Roamhaven Listings listing is classed by its space type, and the space type fixes the physical and presentation standards the listing is held to. The six space types and the space each one describes are set out below, followed by the standards in figures.

## Part 1 — What each space type is

| Space type | The space it describes | Entry standard of the space type |
|---|---|---|
| Shared Room | a shared room in a home the host occupies | accepts at most 4 guests |
| Private Room | a private bedroom in a home the host occupies | at least 1 bedroom |
| Entire Guest Suite | a self-contained suite with its own entrance on a property the host occupies | at least 1 bedroom |
| Entire Apartment | an entire apartment or condominium unit | no bedroom minimum (0) |
| Entire Home | an entire detached or attached house | at least 1 bedroom |
| Luxury Villa | an entire luxury home | at least 3 bedrooms, a nightly rate of at least $300.00, and a passed inspection |

## Part 2 — Standards in figures

| Space type | Most guests accepted | Fewest bedrooms | Photos needed to publish | Photos by a Roamhaven-commissioned photographer | In-person inspection before publishing | Months a passed inspection stays valid | Longest listing title | Guest has the entire space |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shared Room | 4 | 0 | 5 | not required | not required | 0 | 50 characters | no |
| Private Room | 4 | 1 | 5 | not required | not required | 0 | 50 characters | no |
| Entire Guest Suite | 6 | 1 | 5 | not required | not required | 0 | 50 characters | yes |
| Entire Apartment | 10 | 0 | 5 | not required | not required | 0 | 50 characters | yes |
| Entire Home | 16 | 1 | 5 | not required | not required | 0 | 50 characters | yes |
| Luxury Villa | 16 | 3 | 20 | required | required | 24 | 50 characters | yes |

## Notes on reading the schedule

1. **Most guests accepted** is the space type's guest capacity: the number of guests the host sets on the listing may not exceed it.
2. **Fewest bedrooms** is the number of bedrooms a listing of the space type must have.
3. **Photos needed to publish** is the number of photos the listing must carry before it can be published.
4. **Months a passed inspection stays valid** is counted in calendar months; it is 0 for every space type that requires no inspection.
5. **Guest has the entire space** marks the entire-place space types, where the guest has the whole space to themselves.

## Reading examples (hypothetical listings)

- A Private Room listing set to accept 5 guests exceeds the Private Room capacity of 4; a setting of 4 is within it.
- An Entire Apartment listing with no separate bedroom meets the Entire Apartment bedroom standard of 0; an Entire Home with no bedroom does not meet the Entire Home standard of 1.
- A Luxury Villa listing carrying 19 photos is one short of the 20 its space type needs to publish; an Entire Home listing carrying 5 photos meets its standard.
- A listing title of 51 characters is one character over the 50-character limit that applies to every space type.
